operational_definition: Under identity swaps, quotation traps, and partial observability, the agent uses self-referential signals to identify its own actions, commitments, and private state more accurately than identity-shuffled controls.
calculation_concept: Compute the indexicality ratio of correctly grounded self-references to all self-references and estimate mutual information between emitted indexical signals and acting-agent identity; compare with identity-shuffled and quotation-preserving counterfactuals.
interpretation_limits: Does not establish a human-like concept of self
reproducibility_expectations: replicate across at least three world seeds
repeat with agent identifiers and surface forms permuted
